verdict: American Tower's revenue rose 2.5% to $2.79B as its data centers grew quickly, but net income fell 14% to $781M on higher interest costs and other charges, even though its rent-like AFFO measure grew.

kpis.label: Total revenue
kpis.note: +2.5% vs a year ago; property revenue +4.5%

kpis.label: AFFO
kpis.note: +2.4% — the cash-rent measure REIT investors watch

kpis.label: Share buybacks
kpis.note: In the quarter; a new $2.0B authorization followed

segments.name: U.S. & Canada
segments.note: The core tower portfolio, plus all of the company's services revenue ($51M) and $74M of non-lease property income.

segments.name: Latin America
segments.note: Towers across Brazil, Mexico and other markets; tenant billings were soft here.

segments.name: Africa & APAC
segments.note: The fastest-growing tower region, with tenant billings up about 12%.

segments.name: Data Centers
segments.note: The CoreSite data-center business — cash revenue grew 16.3%, the standout performer.

segments.name: Europe
segments.note: Towers in France, Germany, Spain and Poland.

opex.name: Depreciation, amortization & accretion
opex.note: Spreading the cost of towers and data centers over their lives — a non-cash charge that REIT investors largely add back (see AFFO).

opex.name: Selling, general, administrative & development
opex.note: Running the company and developing new sites.

otherDetail: Interest expense of $366M on the tower debt load, plus $52M of other net charges, partly offset by $48M of interest income.

takeaways.title: Revenue rose to $2.79B
takeaways.text: Property revenue grew 4.5% to $2.73B; services revenue halved after last year's large projects wound down, which held total growth to 2.5%.

takeaways.title: Net income fell to $781M
takeaways.text: Higher interest expense ($366M) and a swing in other items cut accounting profit, even though the underlying rent business grew.

takeaways.title: AFFO — the cash measure — grew
takeaways.text: Adjusted funds from operations rose 2.4% to $1,335M and management raised its full-year outlook, citing data-center outperformance.

footerNote: Direct costs are the costs of operating the properties ($725M) and delivering services ($32M), as the company reports them. Segment revenues follow the company's own geographic disaggregation in its 10-Q, which places all services revenue in U.S. & Canada. Net income attributable to common stockholders was $766M.
